r1_design.does_not_predict: hidden truth, future verification outcomes, task category
r1_design.key_insight: M3's state estimator runs internally on controller-visible snapshot without exposing M3 context to LLM. Representation changes only when observed verified evidence justifies it.
r1_design.name: R1 — Epistemic-Conflict Router
r1_design.offline_result_caveat: T2 identifies all 88 tasks on which always-M3 rescued A1 in the I3.11a corpus. This does not yet prove R1 will rescue all 88, because R1 reaches T2 after following the A1 prefix, whereas always-M3 followed an M3 trajectory from step 0. I3.11c tests the hybrid trajectory directly.
r1_design.rule: A1 until T2 fires (all_hypotheses_eliminated), then M3
r1_design.trigger_terminology: T2 is an observed-state phase transition detector, not a predictor of conflict/DEFER likelihood.

source: I3.11a routing stress trajectories (A1 replays with M3 state computed internally)

T2_all_eliminated.description: all hypotheses eliminated by visible verified evidence
T2_all_eliminated.useful_activation_explanation: 88 of 90 T2 activations are M3 rescue opportunities. The remaining 2 are tasks where both A1 and M3 fail (non-beneficial activations, not false activations under the A1-success denominator).

T3_bilateral_verified_no_unverified.description: verified mutually incompatible evidence AND no visible unverified discriminator
